claims.claim: Complete Wagner-Whitin path costs reduce, up to a path-independent term, to arcs K_i + q_i(D_j-D_i).
claims.boundary: Uncapacitated single-item linear-cost model without backlogging.

claims.claim: No speculative motives imply ordered reduced slopes and a Monge inequality for reduced arcs.
claims.boundary: Monge structure does not make the obvious exact continuous relaxation integral.
No hardness result or unrestricted polynomial-time exact algorithm is claimed.

claims.claim: The weighted infinity-norm distance to a fixed competitor half-space has the stated exact floor-aware piecewise-linear formula.
The frozen-comparator radius is a lower bound on strong prefix stability, is non-increasing in prefix length and is exact for a full selected path.
claims.boundary: It can be strict for a partial prefix.

claims.claim: The frozen-comparator lower certificate is computable by at most T+1 polynomial-size shortest-path and linear programmes.
claims.boundary: The code returns a numerical rather than formal rational certificate.

claims.claim: The supplied positive-floor three-period instance has lower certificate 1.5 and exact strong prefix radius 2.0.
claims.boundary: This proves possible strictness, not a worst-case approximation ratio.

claims.claim: A fixed outside path yields a compact exact inverse linear programme, and the exact radius is the minimum over the finite outside-path disjunction.
claims.boundary: Naive disjunctive enumeration is exponential in the worst case.

claims.claim: The fixed-radius mixed-integer model exactly represents the decision problem in mathematical arithmetic.
claims.boundary: A feasible witness is directly checkable; solver-side negative results are not formal infeasibility certificates.

claims.claim: The split-conformal order statistic gives at least 1-alpha marginal revision-score coverage under exchangeability.
claims.boundary: Ordinary exchangeable coverage can fail under drift.

claims.claim: A conformal threshold strictly below a deterministic lower certificate limits the next prefix-violation probability to alpha under the calibration assumptions.
claims.boundary: Revision vectors must align in units, horizon, vintage and missingness treatment.

claims.claim: Rolling realised regret telescopes into Bellman residuals and is bounded by the ordered-slope coefficient diameter times revision excess beyond each certified dead zone.
claims.boundary: The bound is deterministic and may be conservative; synthetic tests do not establish operational representativeness.

claims.claim: The exact weighted coefficient diameter of suffix paths from a is sum_{t=a}^T (q_a-q_t)/w_t.
claims.boundary: Canonical uncapacitated suffix path family with ordered slopes.

claims.claim: The bounded literature search did not locate the complete combined decision object and theorem chain.
claims.boundary: Not proof of absolute novelty or priority.
